author: Nintendo of America
description:
Pokémon Pokopia is available now, only on Nintendo Switch 2: https://ninten.do/6001Q5UmJ

Shape the world and build a cozy new life with Pokémon! As a Ditto that’s transformed to look like a human, you’ll gather materials to create items and furniture, till the fields to grow crops and cook them into delicious meals, create habitats for the Pokémon you meet, and more! You might even encounter a Legendary Pokémon! 

You can also invite up to three other players, via local wireless* or online**, to visit and hang out together—and each of them can bring a Pokémon along. You can even invite a friend who doesn’t have the game—whether they are on Nintendo Switch 2 or Nintendo Switch—by using GameShare***!

* Additional games and systems required for multiplayer mode. Sold separately.

** Any Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) and Nintendo Account required for online features. Membership auto-renews after initial term at the then-current price unless canceled. Not available
title: Pokémon Pokopia – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
